title.narrative: Strengthening Health Systems capacity to provide equitable, effective and efficient package of comprehensive and quality health services to Ethiopian people - Ethiopia (01-Jan-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Ethiopia, RSSH, Federal Ministry of Health of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia (FMOH)This program has the following goals: Ensure everyone who needs health services (promotion, prevention, curative, rehabilitative and palliative services) is able to get them without undue hardship.. The objectives of this program are: Improve development and management of human resources for health: Improve human resources planning, development and management. The focus is on recruitment as per the need, deployment of staff, performance management and motivation.. Improve regulatory systems: Improve the regulatory system through implementation of an effective, transparent and accountable system that ensures adherence by all state and non-state actors to the standards set by the country‚Äôs rules and regulations.. Improve supply chain and logistics management: Ensure access to quality assured, safe, effective and affordable essential medicines with which the sector intends to respond to the majority of health problems of the society; significant reduction in pharmaceutical wastage and improved rational drug use.. Improve research and evidence for decision-making: Improve decision making through evidence generation, translation and dissemination. Promote and advocate the culture of generating quality data, ensuring transmission and acquisition of complete and timely data, verification, analysis and synthesis of data from multiple sources and using evidence at all levels to improve quality and equity of health services.. Enhance use of technology and innovation: Enhance use of the existing technology, introduction of new technology, technology transfer and development and use of local technology.. Improve efficiency and effectiveness: Proper allocation, efficient utilization, tracking and controlling of resources. It also entails harmonization and alignment among stakeholders to strengthen the financial and procurement management system of the government, to minimize wastage of resources and duplication of efforts.
